guide.description: Step-by-step guides to set up and use eKsięgowy AI.

ksef.title: KSeF
ksef.description: Working with Poland's National e-Invoicing System.

getTokens.title: How to get KSeF tokens
getTokens.summary: Generate an authentication token in the KSeF portal and connect it to eKsięgowy AI.
getTokens.intro: To send and receive invoices through KSeF, eKsięgowy AI needs an authentication token issued by the KSeF portal. This guide walks you through generating one and pasting it into the app. You will need a Qualified Electronic Signature (KEP) or a Trusted Profile (Profil Zaufany).

steps.title: Open the KSeF portal
steps.body: Open the KSeF portal in a new tab. Use the test environment first to verify your setup; switch to production once you are confident.

screenshot.caption: Sign-in page of the KSeF Taxpayer Application. Choose Login.gov.pl (mObywatel, banking, Profil Zaufany) or Certyfikat kwalifikowany.
screenshot.placeholderHint: Screenshot of the KSeF Taxpayer Application sign-in page with two large buttons: 'Login.gov.pl' and 'Certyfikat kwalifikowany'.

steps.title: Sign in and select your entity
steps.body: After clicking your chosen sign-in method, complete the authentication flow (mObywatel, banking, or Profil Zaufany via Login.gov.pl, or your qualified certificate). When you return to KSeF, enter the NIP of the entity on whose behalf you'll act.

screenshot.caption: Enter the NIP of the company on whose behalf you'll issue and receive invoices.
screenshot.placeholderHint: Screenshot of the entity-identifier screen with a NIP input field and a 'Przejdź dalej' button.

steps.title: Open the Tokens section
steps.body: After signing in, go to Uprawnienia → Tokeny in the side menu.

screenshot.alt: KSeF dashboard with side menu showing Tokeny
screenshot.caption: KSeF dashboard. The side menu lists Faktury, Historia sesji, Uprawnienia, Tokeny, and Certyfikaty.
screenshot.placeholderHint: Screenshot of the logged-in KSeF dashboard with the side menu visible on the left.

steps.title: Fill out the token form
steps.body: Open Tokeny → Generuj token in the side menu. Give the token a recognizable name (for example, 'eKsiegowyAI'). Below the name, tick the permissions eKsięgowy AI needs: 'wystawianie faktur' (issue invoices) and 'przeglądanie faktur' (view invoices). Do not grant administrative rights.

screenshot.alt: Token generation form with name input and permission checkboxes
screenshot.caption: Token form: name input on top, permission checkboxes below.
screenshot.placeholderHint: Screenshot of the token form showing a 'Nazwa tokena' input and a list of permission checkboxes (wystawianie faktur, przeglądanie faktur, ...).

steps.title: Generate and wait
steps.body: Click 'Generuj token' at the bottom of the form. KSeF queues the request — the status screen shows 'W realizacji' (in progress). Click 'Odśwież' periodically to refresh status. Generation can take a few minutes.

screenshot.caption: 'Generowanie tokena' status screen — click 'Odśwież' to update.
screenshot.placeholderHint: Screenshot of the token-generation status page showing 'W realizacji' state with an 'Odśwież' button.

steps.title: Copy the token
steps.body: When generation finishes, the screen shows 'Zakończono pomyślnie' (completed successfully). The token appears in a copy field with a 'Kopiuj' button. KSeF warns 'Token wyświetlany jest tylko raz' — copy it immediately to a password manager.

screenshot.alt: Generated token displayed with Copy button
screenshot.caption: Token generation complete. Click 'Kopiuj', then store the token in a secure place.
screenshot.placeholderHint: Screenshot of the success screen with the token string in a copy field, a 'Kopiuj' button, and a warning that the token is shown only once.

steps.title: Paste the token into eKsięgowy AI
steps.body: Open KSeF settings in our app. Choose 'Direct KSeF API' as the integration mode and the matching environment (Production, Demo, or Test — the same one you used in KSeF). Paste the token into 'KSeF Authorization Token', enter your NIP, then click 'Save Settings'.

screenshot.alt: KSeF settings page in eKsięgowy AI
screenshot.caption: /ksef/settings page — fill in the token and NIP, then click Save Settings.
screenshot.placeholderHint: Screenshot of our /ksef/settings page with Direct KSeF API selected, environment dropdown, and Token + NIP input fields.

tokenOnce.title: The token is shown only once
tokenOnce.body: If you lose it, you must generate a new one. Store it in a password manager or your team's secret vault.

testFirst.title: Use the test environment first
testFirst.body: Generate a token in the KSeF test environment, verify it works in eKsięgowy AI, then repeat the process for production.

appSettings.label: Open KSeF settings in eKsięgowy AI

telegram.title: Telegram Bot
telegram.description: Set up the Telegram bot for mobile AI chat and receipt scanning.

setup.title: How to set up the Telegram bot
setup.summary: Link your Telegram account and start using AI chat on mobile.
setup.intro: The eKsięgowy AI Telegram bot gives you AI chat on mobile, receipt scanning via photo, and automatic tax deadline reminders — all without opening the web app.

steps.title: Find the bot in Telegram
steps.body: Open Telegram on your phone or desktop. In the search bar, type @eKsiegowyAIBot and open the chat. You can also use the quick-start button in the setup wizard.

steps.title: Get your 6-digit link code
steps.body: In the bot chat, send the /link command. The bot replies immediately with a 6-digit code valid for 5 minutes. Keep this code ready — you will paste it into the eKsięgowy AI web app.

steps.title: Enter the code in eKsięgowy AI
steps.body: In the web app, open the Telegram setup page and enter your 6-digit code, then click Link. Your accounts will be connected and you'll see a confirmation.

codeExpiry.title: Code expires in 5 minutes
codeExpiry.body: If the code expires before you enter it, send /link again in Telegram to receive a new one.

wfirma.title: wFirma
wfirma.description: Connecting eKsięgowy AI to your wFirma account.

getApiCredentials.title: How to get wFirma API credentials
getApiCredentials.summary: Generate API credentials in wFirma and paste them into eKsięgowy AI.
getApiCredentials.intro: Our wFirma integration needs three values: Access Key, Secret Key, and Company ID. This guide walks you through generating them in wFirma and connecting them to eKsięgowy AI.

steps.title: Sign in to wFirma
steps.body: Open wFirma in a new tab and sign in with your account.

screenshot.caption: wFirma sign-in page.
screenshot.placeholderHint: Screenshot of wfirma.pl/login showing the email/password form.

steps.title: Add a new API key in wFirma
steps.body: From the dashboard, find the Bezpieczeństwo section in the right column and click 'Aplikacje'. In the modal that opens, switch to the 'Klucze API' tab and click '+Dodaj' to create a new API key. Give it a recognizable name (for example, 'eKsiegowyAI').

screenshot.alt: wFirma Aplikacje modal with Klucze API tab and Dodaj button
screenshot.caption: Aplikacje → Klucze API → +Dodaj. The wFirma dashboard shows the Aplikacje link in the right column; the modal lists existing keys and the '+Dodaj' button creates a new one.
screenshot.placeholderHint: Screenshot of the wFirma dashboard with the Aplikacje link highlighted and the Klucze API tab of the Bezpieczeństwo modal showing the +Dodaj button.

steps.title: Copy Access Key and Secret Key
steps.body: After creation, the new entry appears in the table with Access key and Secret key columns. Copy both values — you will paste them into eKsięgowy AI in the last step.

steps.title: Find your Company ID
steps.body: Return to the wFirma dashboard. Your Company ID is shown next to 'Moja firma' at the top of the page — it is a numeric identifier.

screenshot.alt: wFirma Moja firma header showing Company ID
screenshot.caption: The Company ID is shown next to 'Moja firma' in the dashboard header.
screenshot.placeholderHint: Screenshot of the wFirma dashboard with the 'Moja firma (ID: ...)' header highlighted.

steps.title: Paste credentials into eKsięgowy AI
steps.body: In our app, click your profile avatar in the top-right and choose 'API Credentials'. In the wFirma Integration section, paste your Access Key, Secret Key, and Company ID, then click 'Save'. eKsięgowy AI will validate the credentials against wFirma.

screenshot.alt: API Credentials modal in eKsięgowy AI with wFirma Integration section
screenshot.caption: Our /profile API Credentials modal — paste Access Key, Secret Key, and Company ID, then click Save.
screenshot.placeholderHint: Screenshot of our API Credentials modal with the wFirma Integration section showing Access Key, Secret Key, and Company ID inputs.

secretSafety.title: Keep your Secret Key safe
secretSafety.body: The Secret Key gives full API access to your wFirma account. Treat it like a password — never share it, post it in chat, or commit it to a repository.

appCredentials.label: Open API Credentials in eKsięgowy AI
